description: "Contribute project context"

Capture useful context in a project note, attributed to the contributor. Reconcile project context only for established changes. This is shared understanding, not a chat thread.

Read `.ddt/runtime/ASSISTANT.md` and `.ddt/runtime/WORKFLOWS.md`. Use its shared helper and revision/privacy rules. These commands are convenience entry points; the user can express the same intent naturally.
